as_told.title: The blue 'angel' UAP over Blitch's house

plain: Over the home of a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, an unexplained object he and his family call "the angel" keeps appearing: it is blue, seems to have wings, materializes, hangs over the house where neighbours see it, and then "shoots into outer space". Barber tells this himself on two episodes, once mentioning his son. Michels repeats it second-hand and links it to Barber's crash-retrieval work, and one telling places the house with the scientist John Blitch instead.
